entries.jp: 占い師
entries.en: Fortune Teller

entries.jp: あなたの周囲に光る{FFEB}の星が{n}あなたにどの様な想いを抱いているか、{n}見せてあげようか？
entries.en: Shall I show you what feelings the {FFEB} stars shining{n}around you hold for you?

entries.jp: あなたの周囲に光る{FFEB}つの星が{n}あなたにどの様な想いを抱いているか、{n}見せてあげようか？
entries.en: Shall I show you what feelings the {FFEB} stars shining{n}around you hold for you?

entries.jp: では、心をおだやかにして、{n}星の声に耳をかたむけよ‥‥。
entries.en: Then calm your heart, and listen to the voices of{n}the stars...

entries.jp: そうか。{n}知りたくなったら、いつでも来なさい。
entries.en: I see. Come back whenever you wish to know.

entries.jp: 知りたくなったらいつでも来なさい。
entries.en: Come back whenever you wish to know.

entries.jp: {FFEF}お兄ちゃんのためだったら‥‥、わたし、なんでもできるよ‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}For Big Brother... I could do anything...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}お兄ちゃんが他の女性と話すのを見ると、ちょっと妬けちゃうの‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}When I see Big Brother talking with other women, I get{n}a little jealous...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFF0}えへへっ、お兄ちゃんってカッコいいよね？{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFF0}Ehehe, Big Brother is so cool, isn't he?{FFF1}

entries.jp: カッコいい、わたしのお兄ちゃんだよ。
entries.en: He's my cool big brother.

entries.jp: {FFEE}お兄ちゃん、最近冷たくなったような気がするなぁ‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}I feel like Big Brother's been cold to me lately...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEE}お兄ちゃんが何をしても、わたしには関係ないよ。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Whatever Big Brother does has nothing to do with me.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}歳の差は関係ない。無条件に背中を預けられる男だ。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}Age doesn't matter. He's a man I can trust with my{n}back, no questions asked.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}たまにオレが尊敬する男とダブって見えることがあるな‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}Now and then, I see a man I respect in him...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFF0}並のヤツに比べりゃ、かなりやれる男だな。先が楽しみだ。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFF0}Compared to the average guy, he's pretty capable. I'm{n}looking forward to seeing how he turns out.{FFF1}

entries.jp: 並のヤツに比べりゃ、やれる方だと思うぜ。
entries.en: Compared to the average guy, I'd say he's got what{n}it takes.

entries.jp: {FFEE}まだまだ若造だ。リーダーとしてしっかりして欲しいな。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}He's still just a kid. I need him to shape up as a leader.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEE}サンドラ様の子だから、最後まで面倒は見ようと思う。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}He's Sandra-sama's son, so I intend to look after him to{n}the end.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}ああ、お兄さま‥‥♥　その熱い視線でアタシを焦がしてぇ！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}Ohh, Big Brother...♥ Burn me up with that smoldering{n}gaze!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}アタシ、お兄さま一筋ですからっ！　この想いは誰にも負けませんよ！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}I'm devoted to Big Brother and only him! Nobody's{n}feelings can beat mine!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFF0}もう、最高！　どうしてこんなにカッコいいの？　反則よ！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFF0}Ugh, he's the best! How can he be so cool? It's not{n}fair!{FFF1}

entries.jp: ルイセちゃんのお兄さま、とってもカッコいいですよね～♥
entries.en: Luise-chan's big brother is sooo cool♥

entries.jp: {FFEE}最初に出会ったころより、ちょっと魅力が薄れてきたような‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}He seems to have lost a little of his charm since we{n}first met...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEE}いくら好きでも、こっちを見てくれないなら、仕方ないですよ。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}No matter how much I like him, if he won't look my{n}way, there's nothing I can do.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}ただ、ただ、すごいの一言だね。この世界に彼のような人がいるとは！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}All I can say is: simply amazing. To think a person like{n}him exists in this world!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}実に興味深いね。彼のことを研究してみたい衝動にかられるよ。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}Truly fascinating. I feel the urge to make a study of{n}him.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFF0}辛いことでもやり遂げる姿は、見ているこちらも励まされるよ。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFF0}Seeing him push through even the hard times{n}encourages those of us watching, too.{FFF1}

entries.jp: ルイセ君のお兄さんで、強い意志を持った人だと思うよ。
entries.en: He's Luise-kun's brother, and I'd say he's a man of{n}strong will.

entries.jp: {FFEE}戦いは強いかも知れないけど‥‥、それだけじゃないかな？{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}He may be strong in a fight, but... is that all there is to{n}him?{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEE}彼って、ちょっとヘビっぽくないかい？　ヘビって嫌いなんだよね‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Isn't he a bit snake-like? I really don't care for{n}snakes...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}はしたないですが、気が付くと彼のことを考えているんです‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}It's unbecoming of me, but I catch myself thinking about{n}him...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}あの人のことを考えると、顔が熱くなってしまいます‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}When I think of him, my face grows hot...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFF0}運命の神がいるのなら、彼と会えたことを感謝します。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFF0}If there is a god of fate, I thank it for letting me{n}meet him.{FFF1}

entries.jp: 私を助けてくれた、命の恩人です。
entries.en: He saved me. I owe him my life.

entries.jp: {FFEE}助けてくれたことには感謝しますが、それ以上を期待されても‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}I'm grateful that he saved me, but if he expects{n}anything more...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEE}どうして出会ってしまったのか‥‥。運命の神はヒドイです‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Why did we ever have to meet... The god of fate is{n}cruel...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}オレもオヤジみたく、アイツと傭兵団を作ってみたいぜ！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}I wanna start a mercenary company with him, just like{n}my old man did!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}素直に認めるよ、アイツはスゴイ。その言葉以外、見つからねぇよ。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}I'll admit it straight: the guy's amazing. Can't find any{n}other word for it.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFF0}このオレが勝てないなんて、かなりの腕利きだと思う。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFF0}If even I can't beat him, he's gotta be one hell of a{n}fighter.{FFF1}

entries.jp: カレンを助けてくれた恩人だ。まぁ、腕は立つようだな！
entries.en: He's the one who saved Karen. Well, looks like he can{n}handle himself!

entries.jp: {FFEE}どうしてあんなヤツがローランディアの騎士なんてやってられるんだ？{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}How the hell does a guy like that get to be a knight of{n}Rolandia?{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEE}アイツにカレンを助けられたのが、オレの人生最大の汚点だ‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Having that guy be the one who saved Karen is the{n}biggest stain on my life...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}少しでも一緒にいて、あの方の手伝いをしたいです‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}I want to stay by his side even a little longer, and help{n}him...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}強くて、優しくて、でも飾らなくて‥‥憧れますよね‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}Strong, kind, and yet so unpretentious... I really look up{n}to him...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFF0}どうやったら、あんな風に強くなれるんでしょう。ボクには無理かな？{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFF0}How could I ever get as strong as that? Maybe it's{n}impossible for me?{FFF1}

entries.jp: あの方がいなかったら、ボクは殺されていたかもしれません。
entries.en: If he hadn't been there, I might have been killed.

entries.jp: {FFEE}人間関係で、ちょっとだらしないところがありますよね？{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}He's a little careless when it comes to relationships,{n}isn't he?{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEE}世の中には色々な人がいますが、目標にするなら他の人を選びます。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}There are all kinds of people in the world, but if I need{n}a role model, I'll choose someone else.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}バーンシュタインという鎖がなければ、彼の下に走っているだろう‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}If not for the chains of Burnstein, I would run to his{n}side...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}私の心の迷いも、彼は断ち切ってくれる‥‥。頼りたくなる人だ‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}He cuts through even the doubts in my heart... He is{n}someone I want to lean on...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFF0}剣の強さだけではなく、心の強さも持っている人だ。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFF0}He has not only strength with the sword, but strength{n}of heart.{FFF1}

entries.jp: 彼は心が自由なんだろう。羨ましいと思う。
entries.en: His heart is free, I suppose. I envy that.

entries.jp: {FFEE}彼とやり合っても、負ける気がしない。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Even if we crossed swords, I don't think I would lose.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEE}悪いが、今の私にムダなことを考えている余裕はないんだ。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Forgive me, but I have no room right now to think{n}about pointless things.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}彼のためなら、この命を捨てることなどいとわぬ！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}For his sake, I would gladly lay down my life!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}私が頼れる３人目の男だ。彼がどう思っているかは知らないがな‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}He is the third man I can rely on. Though I know not{n}what he thinks of me...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFF0}あのゲヴェルの支配から、脱することが出来たのだ。すごい男だよ。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFF0}He broke free of Gevel's control. He is an amazing man.{FFF1}

entries.jp: どんな形であれ、命を救ってくれたのだ。礼を言おう。
entries.en: Whatever the circumstances, he saved my life. I shall{n}thank him for that.

entries.jp: {FFEE}ゲヴェルに逆らうのだから、かなり反抗的なのだろう。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}To defy Gevel, he must be quite the rebel.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEE}言うことはない。借りは返す。それだけでいいだろう？{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}There is nothing to say. I will repay my debt. That{n}should suffice, no?{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}私はもう、こっちの世界で生きていくわ。だって彼がいるもの‥‥♥{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}I'm going to live in this world from now on. After all,{n}he's here...♥{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}何で彼のことが気になるのかしら‥‥？　ちょっと悔しいわ。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}Why does he keep weighing on my mind...? It's a little{n}frustrating.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFF0}なかなかやるじゃない？　お姉さん見直しちゃった！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFF0}Not bad at all, is he? Big Sis is impressed!{FFF1}

entries.jp: 無口で何を考えてるかわからないけど、悪い人には見えないわね。
entries.en: He's quiet and I can't tell what he's thinking, but he{n}doesn't seem like a bad person.

entries.jp: {FFEE}ちょっと有名だからって、調子に乗ってるんじゃないかしら？{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Just because he's a little famous, isn't he getting a bit{n}full of himself?{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEE}アイツ、なんなの？　やること全てが鼻につくんだけど‥‥！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}What's with that guy? Everything he does gets on my{n}nerves...!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}彼のことが頭から離れない‥‥。私は壊れてしまったのかもしれないわ。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}I can't get him out of my head... Perhaps something in{n}me has broken.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEF}彼は他の人間とは何か違う。彼を見ると胸がしめつけられる‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEF}He is somehow different from other humans. When I{n}look at him, my chest tightens...{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFF0}人間の可能性‥‥そう言うものを見せてくれる存在ね。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFF0}The potential of humanity... He is someone who shows{n}me that kind of thing.{FFF1}

entries.jp: 悪いヤツではなさそうだが、人間は人間よ。
entries.en: He doesn't seem to be a bad sort, but a human is still{n}a human.

entries.jp: {FFEE}人間に興味はない。つきまとわないで欲しいわ。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}I have no interest in humans. I'd rather he didn't follow{n}me around.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEE}人間の中でも最悪な存在ね。存在自体を消してしまいたい‥‥。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}He is the very worst of all humans. I wish I could erase{n}his existence entirely...{FFF1}
